material.acceptance_criteria: A schema file under docs/ and a small reader parse every server log line into key=value records.
material.description: A schema file under docs/ and a small reader parse every server log line into key=value records.
material.resolution: docs/LOG_SCHEMA.md documents all 29 log events with fields; the log-schema CI job parses the server log and fails on an undocumented field, an unknown event or a missing required event. Printed log schema ok events=29 documented=29 lines=1138 seen=10.
material.subject: Structured server log has a grammar in code but no documented reader or schema
material.witness_plan: server-log-grammar job (ci.yml line 1047) pipes its output through the documented reader and fails on any unparsed line. Evidence: rust/crates/server/src/log.rs:1-9 documents the grammar only in comments; no docs/*.md or reader references it.
